verdict.rationale: Calendly's webhook documentation confirms that invitees themselves can cancel or reschedule meetings, and that a reschedule is handled as a cancellation plus a new booking. The evidence never shows how invitees do this from their confirmation, how policies are enforced, or how connected calendars are updated. Calendar sync is documented only for conflict checking before a booking. Missing for 10: reschedule/cancel links in confirmation emails, configurable policies (e.g., minimum-notice or cancellation windows), calendar updates across connected calendars after a change, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, invitees can reschedule or cancel from their confirmation, with my policies enforced and calendars updated everywhere

citations.quote: lets you automatically receive Calendly data with webhook subscriptions anytime invitees schedule, cancel, or reschedule a meeting
When an invitee reschedules an event, both webhook events (`invitee.created` and `invitee.canceled`) will be triggered.
payloads will be sent in real time to your server endpoint when events are scheduled or canceled by either the host or the invitee
